018package org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup;
019
020import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.BackupInfo.withState;
021import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.TestBackupUtils.assertBackupCompleteFileDoesNotExist;
022import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.TestBackupUtils.assertBackupCompleteFileExists;
023import static org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.BackupSystemTable.Order.NEW_TO_OLD;
024import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertEquals;
025import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertFalse;
026import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertNotEquals;
027import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertThrows;
028import static org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions.assertTrue;
029
030import java.io.IOException;
031import java.util.List;
032import java.util.Set;
033import org.apache.hadoop.conf.Configuration;
034import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.TableName;
035import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.BackupInfo.BackupState;
036import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.BackupSystemTable;
037import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.ExclusiveOperationException;
038import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.TableBackupClient;
039import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.backup.impl.TableBackupClient.Stage;
040import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.client.Connection;
041import org.apache.hadoop.hbase.testclassification.LargeTests;
042import org.apache.hadoop.util.ToolRunner;
043import org.junit.jupiter.api.Tag;
044import org.junit.jupiter.api.Test;
045import org.slf4j.Logger;
046import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
047
048@Tag(LargeTests.TAG)
049public class TestBackupRepair extends TestBackupBase {
050
051  private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TestBackupRepair.class);
052
053  @Test
054  public void testFullBackupWithFailuresAndRestore() throws Exception {
055
056    autoRestoreOnFailure = false;
057
058    conf1.set(TableBackupClient.BACKUP_CLIENT_IMPL_CLASS,
059      FullTableBackupClientForTest.class.getName());
060    int maxStage = Stage.values().length - 1;
061    // Fail stage in loop between 0 and 4 inclusive
062    for (int stage = 0; stage < maxStage; stage++) {
063      LOG.info("Running stage " + stage);
064      runBackupAndFailAtStageWithRestore(stage);
065    }
066  }
067
068  public void runBackupAndFailAtStageWithRestore(int stage) throws Exception {
069
070    conf1.setInt(FullTableBackupClientForTest.BACKUP_TEST_MODE_STAGE, stage);
071    try (BackupSystemTable table = new BackupSystemTable(TEST_UTIL.getConnection())) {
072      int before = table.getBackupHistory().size();
073      String[] args = new String[] { "create", "full", BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, "-t",
074        table1.getNameAsString() + "," + table2.getNameAsString() };
075      // Run backup
076      int ret = ToolRunner.run(conf1, new BackupDriver(), args);
077      assertNotEquals(0, ret);
078
079      // Create a stale .backup.complete marker and verify repair removes it
080      List<BackupInfo> runningBackups =
081        table.getBackupHistory(NEW_TO_OLD, 1, withState(BackupState.RUNNING));
082      assertEquals(1, runningBackups.size());
083      String failedBackupId = runningBackups.get(0).getBackupId();
084      HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
085      assertBackupCompleteFileExists(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
086
087      // Now run restore
088      args = new String[] { "repair" };
089
090      ret = ToolRunner.run(conf1, new BackupDriver(), args);
091      assertEquals(0, ret);
092
093      List<BackupInfo> backups = table.getBackupHistory();
094      int after = table.getBackupHistory().size();
095
096      assertEquals(before + 1, after);
097      for (BackupInfo data : backups) {
098        String backupId = data.getBackupId();
099        assertFalse(checkSucceeded(backupId));
100        assertBackupCompleteFileDoesNotExist(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, backupId);
101      }
102      Set<TableName> tables = table.getIncrementalBackupTableSet(BACKUP_ROOT_DIR);
103      assertEquals(0, tables.size());
104    }
105  }
106
107  // Verifies that if repair fails because the .backup.complete marker cannot be deleted, then it
108  // fails before any destructive recovery step. The failed backup stays discoverable, and a later
109  // repair can finish the recovery and release the backup exclusive lock.
110  @Test
111  public void testRepairRetriesAfterMarkerDeleteFailure() throws Exception {
112    autoRestoreOnFailure = false;
113    conf1.set(TableBackupClient.BACKUP_CLIENT_IMPL_CLASS,
114      FullTableBackupClientForTest.class.getName());
115    // Fail after the table snapshots are taken, leaving the backup RUNNING with the lock held
116    conf1.setInt(FullTableBackupClientForTest.BACKUP_TEST_MODE_STAGE, Stage.stage_3.ordinal());
117
118    Connection conn = TEST_UTIL.getConnection();
119    try (BackupSystemTable table = new BackupSystemTable(conn)) {
120      String[] args = new String[] { "create", "full", BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, "-t",
121        table1.getNameAsString() + "," + table2.getNameAsString() };
122      assertNotEquals(0, ToolRunner.run(conf1, new BackupDriver(), args));
123
124      String failedBackupId = assertSingleRunningBackup(table);
125      // Create a stale .backup.complete marker that repair has to remove
126      HBackupFileSystem.writeBackupCompleteMarker(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
127      assertBackupCompleteFileExists(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
128
129      // Run repair with a file system that cannot delete the marker
130      Configuration markerFailConf = BackupTestUtil.createMarkerDeletionFailConf(conf1);
131      args = new String[] { "repair" };
132      assertNotEquals(0, ToolRunner.run(markerFailConf, new BackupDriver(), args));
133
134      // Nothing should have been rolled back: the backup is still RUNNING, the backup system table
135      // snapshot still exists, the marker is still present, and the lock is still held
136      assertEquals(failedBackupId, assertSingleRunningBackup(table));
137      assertTrue(BackupSystemTable.snapshotExists(conn));
138      assertBackupCompleteFileExists(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
139      assertThrows(ExclusiveOperationException.class, table::startBackupExclusiveOperation);
140
141      // Clear the failure and repair again
142      assertEquals(0, ToolRunner.run(conf1, new BackupDriver(), args));
143
144      assertFalse(checkSucceeded(failedBackupId));
145      assertEquals(0, table.getBackupHistory(NEW_TO_OLD, 1, withState(BackupState.RUNNING)).size());
146      assertFalse(BackupSystemTable.snapshotExists(conn));
147      assertBackupCompleteFileDoesNotExist(conf1, BACKUP_ROOT_DIR, failedBackupId);
148      // The lock must have been released
149      table.startBackupExclusiveOperation();
150      table.finishBackupExclusiveOperation();
151    } finally {
152      conf1.unset(TableBackupClient.BACKUP_CLIENT_IMPL_CLASS);
153      conf1.unset(FullTableBackupClientForTest.BACKUP_TEST_MODE_STAGE);
154    }
155  }
156
157  private static String assertSingleRunningBackup(BackupSystemTable table) throws IOException {
158    List<BackupInfo> runningBackups =
159      table.getBackupHistory(NEW_TO_OLD, 1, withState(BackupState.RUNNING));
160    assertEquals(1, runningBackups.size());
161    return runningBackups.get(0).getBackupId();
162  }
163}
